findings.title: Recheck the cache after acquiring the write lock
findings.body: When concurrent non-development calls all observe an empty cache, each waits for this lock and then performs the full manifest load because the cache is not checked again after locking. This serializes redundant file/network work and can overwrite a value another caller has just populated. Recheck `entryPointAssetsCache` under the lock and return it for non-development calls before loading.
